title: Explaining a Complex Scientific Concept
grammar: Integrating amennyiben, feltéve, hogy, and minél... annál in analytical exposition
goal: I can synthesize formal conditionals, proportional correlatives, and manner clauses in analytical prose.
I can explain complex mind-body and scientific concepts clearly to an educated reader.
I can read and analyze Frigyes Karinthy's Utazás a koponyám körül at B2 level.
